evidence.quote:
Location: PAZUZU'S TOWER
Suggested Level: 32

subject: Norma
text: Talking to the little girl reveals she is Norma, and she will return home.

evidence.quote: Talk to the little girl, who turns out to be Norma. She will return home.

subject: 6F
text: From the bottom set of stairs on 6F, go left and get the Flare spell.

evidence.quote: 6F: From the bottom set of stairs, go left and get the Flare spell.

subject: 4F
text: On 4F, go down, through the door to the right, and up to get the Excalibur sword, which is the strongest weapon in the game.

evidence.quote: 4F: Go down, through the door to the right, and up to get the Excalibur sword, which is the strongest weapon in the game.

subject: elevator
text: On 6F, whacking the switch with your Axe causes the elevator to be closed.

evidence.quote:
whack the
switch with your Axe. The elevator will now be closed.

subject: elevator
text: On 4F, whacking the switch with your Axe will cause the elevator to close again.

evidence.quote:
whack that switch with your
Axe. The elevator will again close.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Pazuzu has 25,000 hit points and gives 618 experience.

evidence.quote:
PAZUZU
Hit Points: 25,000
Experience Given: 618

subject: Pazuzu
text: Do not attack Pazuzu when he puts up his Psychshield, as he will counter attack anything you do with a strong Wind attack.

evidence.quote:
remember not to attack him when he
puts up his Psychshield. When it is up, he will counter attack anything you do
with a strong Wind attack.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Pazuzu will put his Psychshield back down after about three or four turns, sometimes even five, and will not do anything while it is up, making it a great time to cure.

evidence.quote:
He will put it back down after about three or four
turns, sometimes even five. He won't do anything while he has his shield up, so
that is a great time to cure.

subject: Pazuzu
text: When his shield is not up, use Flare and Aero to defeat Pazuzu.

evidence.quote:
When his shield is not up, use Flare and Aero to
knock him on his behind.

subject: Pazuzu's Tower
text: After Pazuzu dies and the Crystal of Wind is restored, collect the Sky Coin from the red chest.

evidence.quote:
the Crystal of Wind will be
restored. Yay! You restored all 4 crystals! Collect the Sky Coin from the red
chest

subject: Arion

evidence.quote: Location: FIREBURG...Head to Reuben's house, and talk to Arion. He will give you the Thunder Rock.

subject: Kaeli
text: Talking to Kaeli at Otto's in Windia gives you the Captain Cap.

evidence.quote: Location: WINDIA...Head to Otto's and talk to Kaeli. She will give you the Captain Cap.

subject: Spencer's Place
text: In Spencer's Place, throw a bomb at the door and head to the Gemini Crest to warp into a cave and get the Mobius Crest.

evidence.quote:
Throw a bomb at the door, then head to
the Gemini Crest. You'll warp into a cave, and you can walk out of the hole. Get
the Mobius Crest.

subject: 5F
text: To traverse 5F to the boss, go to the edge of the lava, jump up 4 times, right 8 times, go down using the claw, go up to the other edge, jump up 4 times, go to the left edge, jump left three times, down four times, go left using the claw, jump up six times, head left, go down, right, and up, go to the right lava edge, use the claw, go up, and jump up twice.

evidence.quote:
5F: Go to the edge of the lava. Jump up 4 times, right 8 times, and go down,
using the claw. Go up to the other edge, jump up 4 times, go to the left edge,
jump left three times, down four times, and go left, using the claw. Jump up
six times, head left, go down, right, and up. Go to the right lava edge. Use
the claw, go up, and jump up twice to meet the boss.
